handoff: Approve: AC1-AC8 covered by integration tests in packages/cli/test/config.test.ts, AC9 re-checked by hand (one-line git diff for set and unset, comments kept). Tests and typecheck green. Minor: agents.<name> seeded from built-in rather than the user layer's agent; nit: no test for --user+--repo together.

findings.title: A new agents.<name> entry is seeded from the built-in agent, not from the layer below
findings.detail:
setIn seeds `agents.<name>` from DEFAULT_CONFIG when the edited file lacks it. When the user file defines `agents.claude` with its own args, `config set agents.claude.model opus --repo` writes the built-in args into the repo file, which then replaces the user's agent whole (K2) and silently drops the user's args. Recorded as a decision in the handoff; the spec does not cover it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Seed from the resolved agent of the lower layers (or say in the set output that the agent entry was created from the built-in one).

findings.title: --user and --repo together has no test
findings.detail:
layerFile turns both flags into a usage error; no test pins it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add one case to the B65 test.
